tex_content.html:
Definition
[$L^2$ inner product of tensors]

Source: petersen:page-0050 ↗ def:pet-ch1-pointwise-tensor-inner ↗ def:pet-ch1-volume-form-oriented

For compactly supported tensors $T_1,T_2$ of the same type, define \[ (T_1,T_2)_{L^2}=\int _M g(T_1,T_2)\, \operatorname {vol}. \] This is an inner product on the space of compactly supported tensors of that type.
